fields.title: Vulnerabilities are found, prioritised and closed to a timeframe

sections.Purpose: We look for weaknesses in our systems before somebody outside reports them. We rank what we find by the risk it actually presents. We then close findings inside a set timeframe, or record who is accepting the risk of leaving them open.
sections.Scope:
The full stack of systems we build or operate: application code, dependencies, container images, infrastructure and configuration. It covers findings from our own testing and from external reports.

_Boundary: this policy owns finding a vulnerability, prioritising it and closing it, wherever it is. [pol-TRUS](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/engineering/policies/security/trus-trusted-components.md) owns whether we take a component on at all: its source, its provenance and its licence._
sections.Exceptions: A finding is accepted instead of fixed only where it is not exploitable in our context, or where the fix presents greater risk than the finding does. That acceptance is recorded under [pol-DEVI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/engineering/policies/governance/devi-deviations.md) with a named risk owner and a review date.
